description: Historical OHLCV time-series bars and corporate event calendar for a single ticker: returns open, high, low, close, volume and period return across configurable timeframes (1m, 5m, 15m, 30m, 1h, 1d, 1wk, 1mo) and date ranges (from, to), plus optional earnings calendar (upcoming and historical EPS estimates vs actuals), dividends and stock splits. Use for historical charts, backtesting and corporate event lookup; for the current spot tick only, use get_quote.

from.description: Optional start date in YYYY-MM-DD format

include_events.description: Include quarterly earnings calendar (EPS estimate vs actual), dividend ex-dates and stock splits alongside the OHLCV series

limit.description: Maximum number of most recent bars to return, 1-250 (default 30)

symbol.description: Ticker in standard market notation, e.g. AAPL, BRK-B, BTC-USD, EURUSD=X

to.description: Optional end date in YYYY-MM-DD format

name: get_price_history
